reviews.text: I love this place! I have had nothing but positive experiences with HFPC since my first phone call with them. Everyone is so friendly and genuinely caring with the animals. They are always very responsive whenever I send questions via email or call. I also love the photos the post of all the dogs throughout the day, and on my dogs first day they made a post about her and sent us home with a huge goodie bag. It’s so welcoming when you walk in, very secure, and overall just a great vibe. I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for daycare and will be sending my pup here for another 50 (dog) years
Took both my dogs for grooming and nail trim. They handled with great care. Both dogs smell so good and it’s been almost a week! Will def be coming back!

This was literally the cutest place ever!

My dog only stayed there for the day but I could tell she had the best time she didn't even want to leave.
The people are so nice and friendly there
and even gave a sweet treat to my dog at the end.
I hope one day we get a chance to visit
There again 🩷
I’ve always had a great experience at Hills. When my pup recognizes where we are going she dashes to the front door and paws the glass doors until she gets in. That says pretty much everything.

We love Hill Family Pet Care - the staff are wonderful, accommodating, and always ready to greet my Sasha with excitement and a smile. The environment they have for the pups creates a comfortable and familiar space vs just being a big, empty room like many other daycare facilities. My pup (previous disliker of daycare) loves going here! Highly recommend this facility!
Back again for another great experience with Hill Family Pet Care. Thanks for Aki's groom & mani/pedi 😂
Super friendly from the beginning! Upfront about everything and communication was beyond great.  Thank you Gisselle and Hill Family Pet Care for taking care of my Monchhichi.

I am able to leave my dog for daycare and feel assured he will be well cared for. Everyone on staff is kind, attentive, and personable. The best feeling is knowing my dog is taken care of and happy to start his day at Hills!

I visited 6 places before I decided to sign up my 2 puppies for daycare and boarding services at HFPC. I have been totally pleased and more importantly my dogs love it. A plus for me is if I have a long day at work I can pick them up by 8pm and if I need longer just a small fee. I’ve never needed 8pm or longer but the fact that it is available is awesome. I feel my dogs are treated like family and it doesn’t get any better than that. ❤️

I boarded my 9 month old Havamalts -Hershi & Mars - twice with Hill Family during the month of July 2026. Staff went over and above the call of duty to make sure my small pups were safe, healthy and happy during their stay. There is nothing like picking up a pup who was given large doses of TLC. Thank you!

This is the best place to leave your dog at when you are traveling. We had an emergency while we were out of country, and we were able to register our dog and have everything set up for him to be onboarded. All conversations happened via phone with Giselle and she was able to accommodate our pet and make him comfortable enough, knowing this was his first time in a place with other dogs. She understood the urgency and made sure to share daily updates with photos and details of his routine. Their instagram profile is constantly updated with pics of all dogs having fun. We will for sure consider Hill Family Pet Care again in our next trip.
So kind to our dog, very clean environment and staff is professional -both groomers and daycare staff.  Highly recommend

I have been really happy with Hill Fam. Pet Care so far. I feel so much more comfortable bringing my two dogs here that I have bringing them to other doggy daycare facilities. My dogs can be a bit nervous with new settings, dogs, and people, and instead of scared, they actually seem excited to go inside! The flexible hours and transportation to and from daycare options are great as well, much more options and flexibility for supporting pet parents than other facilities I have used in the past. It's nice that they do a membership system so that it's less unfamiliar dogs in and out all the time.

Updated: My pups continue to look wonderful after their grooming appointments. We have returned many times since the original review and always leave happy. The pups also attend daycare weekly and have boarded overnight many times and always have a great time. We love Hill Family!

My pups loved their first grooming visit! Everyone is so kind and really loves their doggie visitors. They look great and we will be back in the future, no doubt.

My basset hound Copper has been coming to Hill Family once a week for over a year now. Everytime he comes home he’s exhausted from having so much fun at daycare. The staff are always so incredibly kind and professional and have become Copper’s family! We love Hill Family Pet Care!
kept me updated with photos during the boarding, my cat was in an excellent mood when he returned!
Atlas and Paisley love HFPC

Our pup has been going to HFPC for over 3 years now and absolutely loves it. We have done boarding too for long weekends or up to 2wks. We know he is safe in their care. Everyone at HFPC treats him like their own. Clean, safe & friendly space for him to play with his friends and he is always excited to go. Highly recommend HFPC. Owners and staff are great & always there to take care of anything you need &/or any questions. Very happy with our experience at HFPC.

Hill Family Pet Care is the best! The staff are so wonderful, and do such a great job looking after our dog, Bonnie. The facilities are so nice, and Bonnie can't wait to get in the door whenever it's time for dropoff (the best barometer). Having been to several daycares in the city, Hill is definitely the best out there.

Our dog has idiopathic epilepsy, and many daycares refused to take her off the bat when we disclosed her condition. Hill Family Pet Care had the exact opposite response. They asked thoughtful, informed questions about whether her epilepsy was medically managed and controlled, which it is. That conversation immediately reassured me that they truly understand the condition, how it presents, and how to handle it if something unexpected were to occur. They also answered all of my questions about their emergency procedures clearly and confidently, which was incredibly reassuring.

My dog now goes to daycare there one to two times each week and has also boarded there for eight days straight. She absolutely loves it and drags me to the door at every drop off. Everyone who works there treats her like their own, and it is such a massive relief to have found a place I trust completely. I highly recommend Hill Family Pet Care.
Hill Family is top notch! Max my corgi loves them and I can trust they treat him well.

Ted has been going to Hill Family since he is a puppy, he always has such a great time that he comes back home exhausted ready for a long nap. The staff is great and very sweet with the dogs. Highly recommended!! Hill Family’s grooming service is also great and super convenient!!

we love hill family! we've been doing daycare, boarding, and grooming with them for about a year now and have had a great experience all around. we have a basset hound who is quite anxious, but she loves hanging with her dog friends, and though she’s slow to warm up to most people, she still does her happy wiggle when any of the staff takes her back. it’s been a great resource and comfort to us! the team definitely goes above and beyond. and seeing updates on socials of my girl chillin through the day get me through leaving her! she comes home happy and sleepy :)
Noodle and I love Hill! She has a blast every time she stays either for daycare or boarding. She's made so many friends. The staff is so friendly and amazing!!

My dog Hendricks goes to Hill Family for daycare and grooming, and we’ve been really happy with the experience. The staff takes great care of him (and me) and he always seems happy to be there. His bath was amazing—he smelled great for days! I’d definitely recommend them.

My puppy has been going to daycare at Hill Family Pet Care for almost a year now and I could not be happier with the experience. My dog loves going and the staff treat like she was their own. I’m so glad that they in the neighborhood!

Amazing new daycare! Our pup loves it! He comes home smelly so nice and smiling ear to ear. The facility is very clean and smells wonderful. The staff is wonderful! Easy drop off and pick up. I enjoy watching the daily social media posts 💕 My boys, 3 1/2 & 6, attend school next door and absolutely love dropping off and picking up their brother” pup from Hill Family Pet Care 💕 highly recommend!

We have had an amazing experience so far. Our pup pulled us into daycare this morning because she was so excited to go. The place is very clean and well organized. Management is very responsive and helpful with answering our questions. They also knew us after just one visit so everything feels very personal. We look forward to trying out boarding in the future!

Update March 2026: We love HFPC!! Our golden gal absolutely thrives there. We recently went on a trip and left Zoe in their care for 8 nights. This was the longest we have ever been away from her. HFPC made me feel extremely comfortable and we received updates every day we were away. When we picked her up, it was clear Zoe had been very well cared for and had her own doggie vacation pawty while we were away. Thank you for all that you do!

Our pup, Chef has been going to Hill for a little over a year now. He loves being there and is always itching to go back!

Staff is always super friendly, accommodating for any rush requests, and is always ensuring that the pets have the best time!

Our puppy absolutely loves Hill Family Pet Care! "Daycare" is one of the few words he knows at the moment and his face lights up anytime he knows he's going. The staff members are incredibly kind and professional. We have seen so much improvement in our puppy since starting daycare with HFPC and now he is a social butterfly who loves interacting with other dogs. We would recommend any pet parents to HFPC!

I’ve been meaning to leave this review for some time… But Hill Family Pet Care is truly the best! We first found them when we needed a new groomer for Luca, and his grooms have always been perfect! They do a great job with the teddy bear cut. When we needed a place for daycare, we could already tell they were so caring and wanted to send him here. Luca is always so excited to go to daycare (and he’s quite attached to us/usually doesn’t like leaving), and he always comes home tired and happy. The staff recognize us and Luca by name. It takes so much stress out of the day-to-day knowing our pup is loved and cared for during the day! They separate dogs by size and this intentionally switches each day depending on which dogs are there. They also post a ton of Instagram updates so you can see your pup throughout the day. The bus system is very reasonably priced and adds to the convenience.  They have loyal customers in us — we wouldn’t go anywhere else now!
Love this place! I feel very comortable leaving my dog here, he always gets a lot of care and comes home tired :)

My dog goes to daycare here 2x/week and he loves it. They have activities once a week and he's come home with some great crafts he "made." He also gets his grooming done here and looks great after every trip.

We have been using Hill Family since they opened, and they never disappoint. The staff is super friendly and our dogs love them. The facility is very clean.  We’ve used them for daycare, overnight stays, and grooming. Our silver lab is … difficult, and the only groomer to whom we can take her is at Hill. Definitely a five—star experience!

Hill Family Pet care goes out of their way to make pet owners feel comforted that their fur babies are well taken care of. I receive pictures of my pup almost daily and I know that my baby loves it there because when we get there he runs right in! All the staff I have met so far are friendly and helpful and always available to answer my questions. Definitely recommend.

From the very first day, Hill Family Pet Care has felt like family.

Hugo has grown up here. Literally. As soon as he was old enough to be around other dogs, this was the very first place I trusted him. I remember dropping him off that first day and crying because I had never left him anywhere before. The care, patience, and reassurance they showed me in that moment told me everything I needed to know.

This isn’t a big, chaotic daycare, it’s intentionally smaller, thoughtful, and personal. They do enrichment activities (bobbing for apples!), creative projects (Hugo came home with his own painting 🥹), and fun dress-up days that show how much they genuinely engage with the dogs. But more than that, they treat Hugo like he’s theirs, not just an animal, but a member of their family. And that’s exactly what their name represents.

What I appreciate most is the reliability. I’m raising Hugo on my own, and life and work happen. Knowing I can call last minute and trust that he’ll be loved, safe, and happy gives me peace I can’t put a price on. I never feel like an inconvenience, only supported.

If you’re looking for a place that leads with heart, intention, and real love for your dog, this is it. I’m beyond grateful for everything Hill Family Pet Care has been for Hugo and for me.

Highly, highly recommend. 🐾💛

We love Hill Family Pet Care! The staff is so kind,  I like that it’s crate-free daycare, and I get to check-in on my dog through the fun instagram posts. They also offer 1:1 walks. I know my dog is in great hands when I bring him here!
Great experience for a new dog like ours!

Horrible service, so rude, Giselle who works there is unapologetic, rude, unprofessional, offensive and basically has zero idea of what customer service is. My dog been training and boarding with them since he was just a baby pup and then I had to stop going there just for the sheer mistreatment. Calling 1 year later to try again and sure as hell getting the same inexcusable treatment. By the way the only horrible grooming service we ever had was at that place as well and my dog was horrified after that.

Since we first brought our puppy, Ernest, to Hill Family for day care, we have been extremely happy with the experience. Giselle, Taylor and Jack are so professional & welcoming that leaving our boy with them is so easy. We feel very lucky to have found this special place for our baby! We cannot envision a better second home for Ernest!

We just returned from a 12 day vacation, with our fur baby happy and settled.  She had excellent play time, and sufficient alone time to eat and rest.  This is the longest she has ever been in board in her 8 years of age, and the happiest when we’ve picked her up.

We are new to the Chicagoland area.  This is the first facility that our little 7-yr-old Toy Fox Terrier has enjoyed from first entry.  She comes home happy (and very tired) every time.
My dog is always happy to go to Hill - and the staff there is always welcoming and friendly. The day care hours are also more flexible than other places we’ve tried.

Hill family pet care is such a warm and welcoming environment.  Penny always comes out of grooming looking so adorable and fresh.  She isn’t afraid to return and get super excited seeing everyone who works there.  A great place with so much to offer your pet

We’ve had a great experience with Hill Family Pet Care! Our sweet Ramona has done daycare, an overnight stay, and grooming, all really great! The grooming was especially amazing, she’s never felt cleaner! Staff are caring, and their flexible pick-up/drop-off makes things so easy. Highly recommend!

My puppy has been going to Hill Family since April.  She goes there weekly for daycare and has boarded there several times.  The staff is always so kind and helpful.  I highly recommend for both daycare and boarding.

We absolutely love Hill Family pet! They take amazing care of my dachshund, he has been going to daycare since 5 months old. He absolutely loves his friends at Hill Family and I love how easy they are to work with and how safe I know he is while there. Thank you!!

I went in because I was curious of daycare for my dog. Right off the bat there was many red flags. The person in front acted confused as to why I would want a tour of the facility. Hello my dogs safety is important to me? The people in back watching the dogs didn't seem to know what they were doing as well alls a dog in a crate was barking the entire time. For a facility that claims to be crate free they are not. Really take a look at these places before trusting your dog.

Jerome and Taylor were so kind throughout the whole process of booking. They came to meet my dog and he instantly loved them. I definitely felt secure as an anxious dog mom. They even left a goodie bag full of treats for my old guy. I highly highly recommend

Hill Family Pet Care is wonderful! My dog, Louie, absolutely loves it here. The staff is warm, attentive, and treats him like family. It gives me so much peace of mind knowing he’s in such good hands. Highly recommend!

Our fur babies love going to Hill Family! We bring both of our dogs for daycare regularly and have also used the boarding services too. The staff is so kind and love seeing our pups run through the door! And yes, they try to run through the door because they are so excited to be there!

The staff also posts lots of updates on social media, so it's easy for us to see how they're doing throughout the day. Spoiler alert: they're always having fun! :)

I highly recommend Hill Family Petcare for their daycare and overnight services. I have an anxious dog who takes time to warm up to new people. Every time we come to HFPC, she pulls me in the door and is so excited to be dropped off. I trust them to take good care of her and love all of the fun activities they organize to make it fun for the pups!
Kind, friendly, and attentive staff who care about your fur baby.  I trust them and know my dog enjoys his time there.

SUPER ACCOMMODATING! They have a unique pricing system. As I now understand it, its 70$ per calendar day. There is no set check in or check out times. If you are only booking for one night it can be kinda jarring because you will have to pay for two days. But if you are like me and need flexibility with pick up, we pushed back our pick up by 6 hours at no extra  cost. The cats were in a pretty good mood too. They are usually really skittish any time they come back home from a trip but they seemed at ease and happy!
Wonderful every time we go they take such good care of Hank and hazel they absolutely adore all the staff that’s there would highly recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a doggy daycare
It was my first time boarding my extremely codependent and anxious cat and they were amazing!! My cat had absolutely ZERO issues and it wad super affordable without insurance
Great expirience and service 5 start!

We love Hill Family and so does our pup! It is so amazing to have a place and people that we trust with our pup for day care and boarding. Every time we drop Bane off he can’t get through the door fast enough because he loves it so much. It’s so great to know they are taking the best care of Bane daily and when he’s been boarded - it can be so hard to find a place where you know your  pup will feelas happy to be at as they are at home and hill family definitely does that! We can’t say enough amazing things about them!

Absolutely amazing staff! Dropped our three dogs there for a long weekend board and they had the best time. The staff is so active on their instagram story, so we got to check-in whenever we wanted to see how they were doing. They made a ton of new friends and had no issues finishing their meals through the stay. Thank you so much to the workers who sent us the nightly emails with pictures of our pups throughout the day! Facility is super clean and there’s a ton of different spots for naps and playtime.
We’ve been bringing our boxer puppy here now for a few weeks and they do a great job. He comes home with a report and is taken care of with great care.

Hill Family has been such a blessing! Riggins now knows the route to "school" as we call it and he cannot contain his excitement. He comes back exhausted and being just under two years old, Hill Family has been an amazing outlet for his energy and offers great options for proper socialization. Thank you for all you do - the facility and team members are top notch!

After my dog sitter cancelled last minute, I checked reviews and found Hill Family. Based on everything I read, it seemed like a great choice but I’ve never had great luck boarding any of my past dogs and my current dog (who I’ve only had for 3 months) is a rescue with some abandonment issues so I was very nervous! But after our first stay, I couldn’t be happier…Axel seemed to have a blast there! They send daily pupdates as well as updating their social media often so you can see what your dog is up to. He came home happy and tired. I’m so happy to have found Hill Family! I’ve used them again since and plan to continue using them in the future!

I can’t say enough good things about Hill Family Pet Care! I recently boarded my senior schnauzer, Sweetie, and was so touched by the love and care she received. It’s not easy leaving an older dog in someone else’s hands, but from the moment we walked in, I could tell Sweetie was in good hands. The staff treated her like one of their own—with kindness, patience, and lots of affection. When I picked her up, she looked so happy and relaxed—it’s like she had a little vacation of her own! It means the world to know there’s a place that truly cares about our furry family members. Thank you for taking such good care of my girl!

I can’t recommend Hill Family Pet Care highly enough! From the very first grooming appointment, I felt completely at ease leaving Truffle in their care. Since then, we’ve returned for more grooming, daycare, and slumber parties — and every visit has been wonderful.

Hill Family Pet Care is my go-to for boarding. Truffle absolutely loves their crate-free environment, and the team has even accommodated a few last-minute requests without hesitation. They consistently provide daily updates and photos that show Truffle playing, relaxing, and clearly having a great time. These little moments mean so much and give me complete peace of mind while I’m away.

Every time I pick him up, he’s all smiles — happy, relaxed, and clearly loved. It’s such a relief knowing there’s a place where Truffle is not only safe, but truly cared for like family. We’ll absolutely be back. Thank you, Hill Family Pet Care, for everything!

So happy I found Hill Family Pet Care (HFPC). I just recently moved to the area and was really struggling to find a daycare for my dog (Lulu). I was referred by a co-worker who also takes her pup here & have no looked back since.

They start your dog off on a trail day (recommend a full day so 8-8/7-8) where both parties decide if it’s the right fit for your pup. They post pictures on their instagram all day & will make a feature post for your dog their trail day and I just loved seeing my Lulu.

All the staff are incredible and have answered any and all questions I have asked them (no matter how dumb😂). Everyone with HFPC really loves dogs and really loves your dog. They knew Lulu’s name after the first trial day & always give me little updates on her when I pick her up.

Unique perks I think are the late hours pick up option (anytime after 8-10:30pm I believe), the free add-ons available for each level of the monthly subscriptions ( treats, walks, etc.), and that the play room has obstacles & toys for dog enrichment.

Truly Hill Family Pet Care is a phenomenal place to take your pup and I’m so happy I found a place for Lulu to have fun in the city!

I’ve attached a few recent photos I have of Lulu from the instagram story, their page post for her trial day, and the trial day goodie bag Lulu received.

Hill Family Pet is great, the people there love animals and it shows. A necessity for all the pet moms and dads that bring their fur babies.  They get to know the pets and make sure they have a fun and comfortable experience. All sorts of services are available, including a variety of training help. And there are always activities planned every week. Our dog Gideon absolutely loved going every time, both for the furry and human friends he made.
This was my first time taking my dog to get groomed at Hill Family. The office staff and groomer were so welcoming and  patient with my anxious dog! I will 100% be a returning customer!

We took Watson for two days while we were in the area and they made such a huge impression on us. Watson was so happy and tired  and clearly cared for at Hill Family Pet Care. Most daycare just leave their dogs running around all day, overstimulated and with begrudging supervision. But you can tell the ladies at Hill Family Pet Care love what they do and they love the dogs they care for - with a rotating range of activities to keep things fresh for the pups (which you can see on the calendar schedule they have up), cozy nap stations (with dogs that actually feel safe enough to nap instead of hiding from the other dogs) and one on one play with the doggie that ask for it, they truly have set the bar for us. His last day he had a bath and tidy and it’s the best groom he’s had comparable to the price anywhere else. His coat and skin looked so moisturized and he still smells good a week later! Even his behavior seems improved when we go on walks and he encounters other dogs he seems more polite than he is when we bring him home from other daycares. All daycares should learn from this one.

Our relationship with Hill Family Pet Care began in 2020 when we needed a special place to take care of our English Bulldog after knee surgery.  We could not have known then what special place HFPC really is and how much they would truly treat us like family.  Every morning the pups RUN in to big greetings and lots of love, and every evening, they have to be dragged out of the fun.  Do not hesitate to check out this most special pet care facility!!

In the past, we have utilized other day care and boarding facilities, and immediately when I walked into HFPC, I knew it was different.  The facilities are beautiful and so well-maintained.  The cleanliness and fresh smell are unsurpassed.  The design also minimizes loud sounds, creating a significantly more calm enironment compared to others.

Not only do we participate in their day care services 3-5 days per week, but we also board the pups over night.  No matter the length of their stay, the pups are clearly so happy and well cared-for.  Every bit of my trust lies in Taylor (owner) and everyone carefully selected to be on her staff.

Their social media presence is not only engaging and fun, but it also gives puppy pawrents the chance to get in on the daily excitement!  I’ve included some pics of my pups loving their time at HFPC.

As a true testament to how wonderful HFPC is, every other dog family in our building has become a part of the HFPC family, too!!

It's a really cute place painted pink. All the dogs seemed super happy playing together and you can see them through the glass. My puppy got the best groom she's had so far for a comparable price to the other places she'd been to. Would definitely return to Hill's.

Hill Family Pet Care is the best!!!! We started taking our corgi, Winnie, when she was just a puppy. The staff are truly amazing and so caring. The environment is extremely interactive and has helped Winnie grow into a social butterfly! She loves playing with other dogs and is always shaking her butt when we drop her off. Their social media page is very active and I loved being able to watch Winnie play with her friends. The groomer is also amazing! We are moving out of the city and so sad to be leaving Hill Family Pet. I would highly highly recommend taking your pups here!!!!

We have no record of you as a client here at Hill Family Pet Care. Can you share some insight onto why you left this negative review? Leaving one star reviews for small businesses that you have never interacted with is very harmful to us and should be taken down by Google.

We have no record of you as a client here at Hill Family Pet Care. Can you share some insight onto why you left this negative review? Leaving one star reviews for small businesses that you have never interacted with is very harmful to us and should be taken down by Google.

We have no record of you as a client here at Hill Family Pet Care. Can you share some insight onto why you left this negative review? Leaving one star reviews for small businesses that you have never interacted with is very harmful to us and should be taken down by Google.
They do such a good job. Super clean and well managed. We look forward to dropping our dog off the next time we’re in town.
We love Hill so much. Our baby is shy and they take such great care of him! I never feel worried to leave him because I know he is loved and having fun!

Our pup Roger loves going to Hill Family to play with friends! The staff is always so welcoming and friendly - it’s nice going to work knowing our pup is in good hands! We also appreciate how clean and vibrant the facilities are.

I boarded my pup there for a board and train, a total of two weeks.  I was very nervous about leaving her there!  It turned out I did not need to worry, she was so taken care of.  I was kept informed about her by videos, pics and emails almost daily.  She loved the trainer and usually does not like men!  I would definitely recommend the training, she has improved but needs a bit more!
Best doggy boarding!!! Sent us a picture every day of our pup’s stay and he was so so so happy! He loves going back!
Very attentive to instructions and got updates to feel secure. Overall felt very comfortable and safe leaving my kitty baby with hill family pet care
Our dog Moose had the best time during his slumber pawty! The staff was always so responsive and kind. Highly recommend!!!
Very happy to have found this boarding facility. We have used them a few times now for boarding and have always been impressed with the facilities and the staff!

Hill Family is truly the best!! We have done both Boarding, Board and Train, and Day Care -- all of the different options have been awesome! The staff is SO friendly and caring, and genuinely excited to see our dog, Finley each time he goes. Finley is also THRILLED to go to Hill Family each time - he get's SO excited to head right into the play area to see his friends. There is a ton of engagement for pets, and most importantly he's HAPPY and EXAHAUSTED when he comes home.

The training experience was also awesome. We did 3 weeks of Board and Train and Matt did an excellent job working with Finley our very high-energy golden retriever, particularly on leash training. We are so grateful for Hill Family and couldn't recommend them more!

New post after boarding:
I am extremely happy with how well taken care of our baby was at Hill Family. He boarded with them for a full week (during Thanksgiving) and I received a daily report as well as followed their stories on IG daily. I enjoyed seeing Billy and the other pups everyday. Whenever I had a question via email, they replied immediately and usually with a phone call. They gave him a nail trim and he was clean when we got him. When we came to pick him up, we watched him from the window before having them retrieve him for us and he seemed so happy! I cannot express how much I appreciate Hill Family Pet Care and will definitely use their boarding services whenever we travel again.

We brought Billy for a trial run at Hill Family and I am impressed with the cleanliness, the friendly and knowledgeable staff and just how calm the atmosphere is with all the dogs. Billy can be very anxious but he readily walked in with the owner and when I picked him up, he wanted to go back in with the play group! I like that I can watch the pups from the window. Their play area looks fun and inviting and someone is always in there even in the wee hours of the night for the dogs who board overnight. That gives me peace since we will board our baby there for the holidays.
The front desk staff was friendly and informative.  Great communication. The groomer did a beautiful job on my huge Great Pyrenees.  Her wash, cut, nails, de-shedding were done to perfection.
Both of my dogs stayed at Hill Family Pet and they had a great time! I really appreciated the daily Pupdates as well.

The best pet boarding facility! I usually bring my dog with me when I travel until I found Hill Family Pet Care. I feel so at ease when my dog stays there. They are so kind, knowledgeable, and take the best care of all of the pets staying …

A 5-star review for a 5-star pet hotel. Our 10-month old mixed breed cavapoo/sheltie (Molly, 15 lbs) stayed for 3 days and 3 nights. We are so happy with this facility. Excellent staff...friendly and welcoming. Great vibe from this place. …

We love Hill Family Pet Care. Our dog Lainey loves going to daycare and boarding there.  They are so friendly and courteous to all of their dogs and parents.  Their facilities are entertaining and fun for all of the dogs.  Super clean as well.
